Priya Patel: Quick sync — we need to finalize what ships in the obs sprint. Customer asks: per-route cost breakdown, error analytics for top routes, and a lower-cost tracing hook option.
Alex Chen: For per-route cost we can expose token-based attribution per request. Backend calc + storage is the work, but UI surface is straightforward.
Marco Rivera: Tracing hooks PR lands tomorrow but sampling logic is WIP. Suggest default sampling 5% for GA to keep costs sane (was 10%).
Sophie Nguyen: Customer specifically wants 95th latency + $ per route in one dashboard tile. Can we show that without full trace retention?
Alex Chen: Yes — approximated cost = token_count * model_cost_profile. Not exact but fast to compute. We should add a confidence note.
TelemetryBot: Automated report — trace volume down 12% this morning after testing sampling changes, estimated infra savings ~$1.2k/day.
Priya Patel: Draft acceptance criteria: (1) per-route cost metric in Console UI (absolute $ + pct delta), (2) tracing hook available with sampling configurable (default 5%), (3) error analytics showing top 10 routes with counts and example traces, (4) canary rollout plan + automatic fallback.
Marco Rivera: Dev plan: add flags `trace_sampling_rate` and `route_cost_enabled`, implement lightweight cost estimator lambda, emit cost metrics to metrics-db. I'll open PR with schema changes.
Sophie Nguyen: UX needs: a single compact tile combining 95th latency + $/route, and a tooltip explaining estimation method + sample rate. Also small CTA to request exact billing for enterprise.
Alex Chen: Operational risk: noisy estimates for high-QPS customers if sampling low. Proposal: allow per-customer override and an opt-in full-retention mode for enterprise customers.
Priya Patel: Decision: ship the estimator + 5% sampling for GA, include per-customer override API and a canary that targets medium-traffic customers first. Marco — can you own the rollout checklist and add rollback criteria?
Marco Rivera: Yep. Will add checklist, monitoring queries, and alert thresholds. Rollback criteria: >10% delta in cost estimate vs billing or >5% user-facing error increase.
Engineering Oncall: Suggest adding a short-lived debugging hook to temporarily bump sampling for a customer in-prod (for incidents).
Priya Patel: Good call — include temporary debug override in the checklist. I'll sync with sales on the enterprise opt-in messaging. Next check-in tomorrow 10:00am. :thumbsup:
